data.description:
## Summary
Implement the Visualizer portion of Demo 13 as a standalone work item. Generate deterministic, audio-synchronized visual effects and support sprite sheet export for game-ready assets.

## User Story
As a game developer, I want ToneForge to generate synchronized visual effects alongside audio so that players receive coherent visual feedback matched to the sound design.

## Expected Behavior
- Visual events are scheduled and rendered in sync with runtime audio events.
- Visual style is palette-aware and reflects selected aesthetic theme.
- Exported sprite sheets are deterministic and usable in game pipelines.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Visualizer produces animated effects synchronized to audio events.
2. Palette changes visually alter generated effects in a consistent way.
3. `toneforge visualize export --recipe <r> --seed <n> --format <f> --output <dir>` produces usable sprite sheet assets.
4. Visual output is deterministic for the same seed and palette.

## References
- `VISUALIZE_PRD.md`
- `PALLETE_PRD.md`
- `docs/prd/DEMO_ROADMAP.md` (Demo 13)

## Dependencies

- Demo 10: Mixer
